<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY internal 'Nested Entity Text'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY rootEnt "Expanded: &internal;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level comment before CDATA block -->
  <?catalog-debug mode="verbose"?>
  <item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section containing entity references like &rootEnt; and tags <item>test</item>.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item id="i2">&rootEnt;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Data Part One">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Part Two">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "sample.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA|sub)*>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Multi-namespace archive document with processing instruction and comments -->
  <?archive-info status="active"?>
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with complex markup: <sub id="1">sub-element content &ent2;</sub>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <sub>&ent2;</sub>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base; Extended">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY file SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-decl "<!ATTLIST node category CDATA #IMPLIED>">
  %dtd-decl;
]>
<?xml-timestamp value="2023-10-25T10:00:00Z"?>
<root xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/root" xmlns:custom="http://schemas.example.com/custom" custom:version="2.0">
  <!-- Comment embedded right before the node list -->
  <?custom-pi command="initialize"?>
  <node category="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      Inside CDATA: arbitrary text &ref; with <tags> and &file; reference simulation.
    ]]>
  </node>
  <node category="secondary">&ref;</node>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY itemB "Beta: &itemA;">
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY photo SYSTEM "photo.tiff" NDATA tiff>
  <!ENTITY % parameter-ent "<!ENTITY dynEnt 'Dynamic Entity Value'>">
  %parameter-ent;
]>
<?xml-hub route="dispatch" priority="high"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://inventory.org/meta" meta:dept="logistics">
  <!-- Inventory header comment containing structural notes -->
  <?meta:log action="audit" user="system"?>
  <stock id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing &itemB; and unescaped characters: <stock>&dynEnt;</stock>
    ]]>
  </stock>
  <stock id="s2">&dynEnt;</stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY name "Libxml2 Fuzzing">
  <!ENTITY desc "Targeting &name; parser robustness">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY payload SYSTEM "binary.bin" NDATA bin>
  <!ENTITY % ext-attr "<!ATTLIST record type CDATA 'default'>">
  %ext-attr;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<database xmlns="http://db.org/schema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://db.org/schema schema.xsd">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block detailing entity expansion tests -->
  <?db-control action="reindex" scope="full"?>
  <record type="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload block: &desc; -- testing CDATA robustness against &payload;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record type="secondary">&desc;</record>
</database>
```
